id: title:Gilbert09:stop retrying corrupted row data as a transient error

review.posthog_relevance: Adds PostgreSQL-specific error handling and recovery behavior to PostHog's ingestion or warehouse connector, distinguishing database page corruption and memory allocation failures as unrecoverable and returning human-readable messages instead of retrying.
review.reason: Adds PostgreSQL-specific error handling and recovery behavior to PostHog's ingestion or warehouse connector, distinguishing database page corruption and memory allocation failures as unrecoverable and returning human-readable messages instead of retrying.
review.uncertainty: The exact PostHog product consuming this connector and the operational benefit of distinguishing these specific database errors are not independently verified; the tier relies solely on the presence of relevant error-handling implementation and its connection to database reliability.

observations.limitations: All supplied hunks are available and complete; no abstention. No score assigned per instructions.

observations.behavior: Adds a new error message constant and its use in the non-retryable error dictionary.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a human-readable explanation for database page corruption errors, distinguishing them from PostHog-side defects.

observations.behavior: Adds a new entry to the non-retryable error dictionary for memory allocation failures, including a friendly message and documentation.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog to recognize PostgreSQL memory allocation failures as unrecoverable and return a helpful message rather than retrying indefinitely.

observations.behavior: Adds a new entry to the non-retryable error dictionary for page corruption errors, including a friendly message and documentation.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog to recognize database page corruption errors and return a helpful message rather than retrying indefinitely.
